method: Four complete pinned files read; blob identities verified. Original dependency-free ngrams executed in51084 cases vs independent sliding-window reference with documented fallback semantics. Isolated original hash_ranges AST method also executed with SimpleNamespace.
findings: ngrams returns empty below min_length, whole sequence when n exceeds length, normal sliding windows otherwise and empty zip for n0. Negative n raises only after minimum-length check; a short input suppresses invalid-n error. With empty input,min_length0,n3 it returns one empty tuple.
51084 combinations length0..32,n-2..40,min_length0..35 match independent reference including raised-error categories. This qualifies helper behavior, not its suitability as a byte-equality proof.

AlgorithmConfig supplies typed fields and RNG initialization but no explicit numeric constraints or cross-field bands/rows checks. MinHash initialization computes defaults only when both absent. Original hash_ranges with bands4,rowsNone yields four(0,0)ranges. Pydantic object creation was not executed, so full-path acceptance is not claimed.
Repeated permutation property access consumes mutable RNG; embeddings may differ if config reused for repeated embedding factory creation. Original full config path not executed.

MinHash optimal parameter tests assert bounds/determinism but different-thresholds-different-results assertion is tautological: result1 != result2 or result1 == result2. No quality regression coverage from that assertion.

Tokenization tests cover normal windows, short/fallback inputs, zero and negative n, tuple/iterator shape and100-token sequence. Comment about memory efficiency only checks iterator interface; no peak-memory measurement.

result.scope: Original ngrams exhaustive comparison; original hash_ranges method isolated with SimpleNamespace, not instantiated Pydantic config.

limits: No full upstream pytest/Pydantic/NumPy/SciPy/Polars pipeline execution. Local helper control is not full-suite result. pHash/ASAN deferred.
